carrier.doc: Carrier: the stainless plate the platen stands on, with the four tabs the lift lifts it by.

frame_ring.doc: Flip frame ring: one layer of the stainless frame the board lives in for the whole job.

frame_shim.doc: Flip frame shim: the 1.6 stainless middle layer of the flip frame, its window the board itself (0.2 slip), so the

lift_arm.doc: Lift arm: the stainless block joining a carrier tab to its MGN12 carriage (or to its T8 nut) on the post.

motor_mount.doc: Motor mount: a 6 mm aluminium plate a NEMA 17's face bolts to (pilot in its 22 bore), standing on or hung from

nut_block.doc: Nut block: the stainless block on the carrier's -x tab that carries the Tr8x8 flange nut on its top.

nut_bracket.doc: Nut bracket: the machined aluminium block a ball screw's nut flange bolts to, hung under its carriage plate; bored

platen_base.doc: Platen base: the bottom layer of the platen, closing the plenum; it stands on the four standoffs. 4 mm 6061, laser

platen_ring.doc: Platen ring: the middle layer of the platen, its window the vacuum plenum under the skin's hole grid.

platen_skin.doc: Platen skin: the top layer of the vacuum platen, the 1 mm hole grid the board lies on.

post.doc: Trunnion post: the upright at each end of the X plate that carries the flip frame's shaft and the platen's lift.

pulley.doc: Pulley: a GT2 timing pulley, drawn at its tip diameter with its hub, for the flip drive (40T on the shaft, 20T on

riser.doc: Rail riser: a 6061 bar (cut from 20 mm plate) a miniature rail is screwed down to, lifting it clear of the ball screw between the rails.

shaft.doc: Shaft: an 8 mm ground steel trunnion shaft, the flip frame's axle, pressed into its trunnion block and turning in a

standoff.doc: Standoff: a stainless spacer between the carrier and the platen's base.

support_block.doc: Support block: a 6061 block (cut from 18 mm plate) under the Y ball screw's BK10 or BF10 on the cabinet floor,

trunnion.doc: Trunnion block: the stainless block screwed to each end of the flip frame that holds its 8 mm shaft on the flip

x_plate.doc: X plate: the 10 mm 6061 plate the X carriages carry, the posts, the platen's lift and the flip motor stand on.

y_plate.doc: Y plate: the 10 mm 6061 plate the Y carriages carry; the X rails' risers, the X screw's supports and the X motor
